name: Hardware-Assisted Polyhedron Projection
aliases: Approximate Volume Rendering for Curvilinear and Unstructured Grids by Hardware-Assisted Polyhedron Projection
definition: A technique using a hardware polygon rendering pipeline with hardware compositing to volume render arbitrary unstructured grids composed of convex polyhedral cells. It requires global sorting for back-to-front compositing.
summary: Hardware-Assisted Polyhedron Projection renders unstructured grids by projecting convex cells to 2D and using hardware pipelines, distinguished by its requirement for global back-to-front cell sorting to ensure correct alpha blending.
